# beankit

> Tiny, sharp open-source TypeScript packages. One package does one job, ships ESM + CJS +
> types with zero runtime dependencies, and holds 100% test coverage (lines, branches,
> functions, statements).

## Packages

Every helper is published both standalone and re-exported from `@beankit/all` (treeshakable;
prefer a single `@beankit/*` package when you need one helper).

- `@beankit/all` (`packages/all`): every utility in one package, plus the `@beankit/all/bigint`
  subpath for native bigint CBOR. Install one of the `@beankit/*` packages instead when you
  need a single helper.
- `@beankit/url-join` (`packages/url-join`): join URL path segments, query strings, and hash
  fragments into one normalized URL. Example: `urlJoin("http://api.test", "v1", "users")`
  returns `"http://api.test/v1/users"`.
- `@beankit/event` (`packages/event`): typed event emitter; listeners run sequentially in
  ascending `order` and `emit` awaits each one. Example:
  `createEvents<{ hello: (name: string) => void }>()`.
- `@beankit/async-reuse` (`packages/async-reuse`): deduplicate concurrent async calls by key
  and reuse resolved results within a lifetime. Example:
  `const users = new AsyncReuse<User>(); users.resolve(() => fetchUser(id), "user:" + id)`.
- `@beankit/async-pool` (`packages/async-pool`): run async tasks over a list with a
  concurrency limit and keep results in input order. Example:
  `await asyncPool(2, ids, (id) => fetchUser(id))`.
- `@beankit/promise-timeout` (`packages/promise-timeout`): race a promise against a timeout
  with fallback, abort signal, and cancelable input. Example:
  `await promiseTimeout(fetchUser(id), { milliseconds: 2000 })`.
- `@beankit/deferred` (`packages/deferred`): `resolve`/`reject` detached from the executor,
  backed by native `Promise.withResolvers` with a fallback. Example:
  `const gate = new Deferred<string>()`.
- `@beankit/cbor` (`packages/cbor`): CBOR encode/decode, BigInt-free by default with an opt-in
  `@beankit/cbor/bigint` subpath. Example: `decodeCBOR(encodeCBOR("hello world"))`.

Planned: `@beankit/typing-event`, `@beankit/replay`.

## Key facts

- Repository: https://github.com/jinganix/beankit (MIT)
- Layout: npm workspaces monorepo; each `packages/*` directory is an independently
  versioned and publishable package with its own README, LICENSE, build, and tests.
- Runtime: Node.js >= 22; every package is platform-neutral (no `node:*` imports, no DOM).
- Conventions: strict TypeScript, extensionless imports, Conventional Commits with scope
  `repo` or a `packages/*` directory name. Direct commits and pushes to `master` are blocked.
- Quality gate: `npm run check` (typecheck + lint + format + test); coverage thresholds are 100%.

## Develop

```bash
npm install
npm run check     # typecheck + lint + format + test (all workspaces)
npm run build
npm run check:packages  # verify publishable tarballs (needs dist/)
./scripts/setup-git-hooks.sh  # enable pre-commit / pre-push / commit-msg hooks
```
